title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - ResponsibleParty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/ResponsibleParty. The legal entity responsible for a BAN, i.e. to contact in case of problem (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthActor. The source ttl declares no rdfs:domain property for ResponsibleParty itself -- it is a pure specialization. It therefore inherits every property of HealthActor (firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan, hasActivity) with nothing of its own declared in the source ontology. ResponsibleParty is the range of Ban.hasResponsibleParty; per ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.3 it should be an organization or a person.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ResponsibleParty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
